lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Observed vertical columns of high-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in a semi-regular grid on the mid-lateral flank; local maxima are spaced roughly equidistantly in the posterior branchial region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the high-luminance blobs to form a grid-like lattice of anchor nodes across the visible flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A dominant linear feature runs horizontally across the upper third of the flank, exhibiting a sharp vertical gradient from high luminance above to a shadow-cast intensity drop below.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of an elongated dark pixel cluster representing a remora (Echeneidae) attached to the ventral-lateral surface posterior to the pectoral fin base.
